meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (4MA1_2F_2406). Derived metadata only. No exam question text transcribed.

coding_notes: q15 IS tagged venn_diagrams, deliberately unlike Jun24 1F q22. Here the student is given a universal set and two sets as lists and must COMPLETE AN ACTUAL VENN DIAGRAM, which is squarely what that skill covers and what its own example question does. The 1F q22 rows were left untagged because there is no Venn diagram in that question at all. The distinction is the diagram, not the set language.
q14(a) is a ROTATION of 180 degrees per the mark scheme; reflection, translation and enlargement are explicitly listed as wrong answers.
q12 tagged proportion for a currency conversion, following the precedent recorded in docs/coding-a-paper.md.
q16 tagged exact_calculations — calculator evaluation with all display figures written down.
q2 spreads five one- and two-mark parts across congruence, enlargement, symmetry, perimeter and area; each is tagged on its own node rather than on a single geometry tag.
No arithmetic series, no calculus and no set NOTATION on this paper.
